title: Grand Theft Auto VI Reveals New Activities and Wildlife in Leonida
seoTitle: GTA VI: New Activities & Wildlife Revealed for Leonida
subtitle: Details on Sports, Aquatic Vehicles, and Leonida's Biodiversity
excerpt: Grand Theft Auto VI, set for November 19, unveils a list of side activities and an ecosystem with over 170 animal species in Leonida, inspired by Florida.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Grand Theft Auto VI, the upcoming title from Rockstar Games, has garnered attention following the release of two lists detailing optional content and the wildlife of the fictional map of Leonida. The information came from specialized publications and explains what players will be able to explore beyond the main storyline.

Side Activities That Expand Exploration

Rockstar confirmed that the game will feature interaction options including sports, aquatic vehicles, and other exploration activities. These functionalities complement the main missions and allow players to discover different ways to enjoy the open world.

Diverse Wildlife in Leonida

Leonida, a fictional state inspired by Florida, will feature over 170 animal species. The survey includes more than 60 types of birds, over 30 terrestrial mammals, as well as various species of fish and reptiles. The ecosystem is distributed across land, air, and sea, bringing together both native creatures and species that have never appeared in Rockstar games.

Central Characters and Setting

GTA 6 will feature two protagonists, Lucia and Jason, a couple with a criminal history who embody a modern version of Bonnie and Clyde. The main setting is Vice City, a fictional version of Miami, which had previously been explored in earlier titles of the series.

Release Date and Platforms

The game is scheduled to be released on November 19, 2026, with versions for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. As of now, Rockstar has not announced a PC version.

Expectations for the First GTA in Thirteen Years

Grand Theft Auto VI represents the first release in the franchise since GTA 5, which arrived in 2013. The combination of new side activities and a rich ecosystem raises fan expectations, who are awaiting the return to Rockstar's open world.

With information from Exame, Omelete.
